name: nonoun-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins: the forge/docs authoring toolchain, and seven domain plugins (agent-protocols, llm, color, typography, design-kits, ui, orchestration) partitioned from a legacy personal skill/agent corpus.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: The foundational authoring plugin, self-contained: forge/standards/lint families for skills, agents, hooks, and entry files; the absorbed language layer (linguistic-techniques), intent extraction, and two-plane decomposition; /harness-audit as the recurring outer loop.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Functional-document authoring: ADR, PRD, SPEC, LLD, PLAN, ROADMAP, TICKET, TASK — standards, forge, review, validator, eight type templates, and file-bug (capture -> classify -> record -> dispatch -> write-back for bug reports). Also covers research/measurement (research-methods, make-rubric), markdown↔markup conversion (markdown-to-markup, html-to-markdown), knowledge/reference authoring (make-reference, make-llms-txt, make-vision-memo — knowledge-pack authoring lives in forge's pack-forge), and a fresh-context doc-checker agent alongside the experiment-runner agent.

plugins.name: agent-protocols
plugins.description: A2UI knowledge packs — wire protocol/renderer, catalog design, the live conversational agent, and the training corpus — answering how @agent-ui/a2ui works from a cited repo corpus; named agent-protocols (not a2ui) to leave room for future Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol material.

plugins.name: llm
plugins.description: Portable LLM-integration and chat-agent-harness knowledge, project-agnostic: the swappable-provider gateway pattern, streaming structured output over JSONL/SSE, and the six-layer construction of a mini/portable chat-agent harness (instructions/guardrails, skills/routing, orchestration/workflows, knowledge/memory, tools/resources/services, observability). Distilled from @agent-ui/a2ui's live-agent implementation and Claude Code's own current harness mechanics, taught as general technique rather than a repo-specific answer pack.

plugins.name: color
plugins.description: Explain color science (accessibility, materials, perception, spaces, theory), build an OKLCH palette, and verify its contrast and CVD-safety.

plugins.name: typography
plugins.description: Choose, pair, and tokenize typography: design an 11-voice typography system from a brand brief, realize it as bound --type-*/--font-* tokens, and answer type-anatomy and lettering questions from a cited corpus.

plugins.name: design-kits
plugins.description: Author and regenerate design-system export bundles for Claude Design/Claude Code, Figma Make, and Google Stitch, plus the Material Design token grammar they can extend.

plugins.name: screens
plugins.description: Design and critique UI structure (layouts, flows, components, patterns) and verify it against non-functional bars (focus, i18n, perf, safety) — plus check-ui-change, which drives the live artifact instead of reasoning about it in the abstract.

plugins.name: teamwork
plugins.description: Derive decisions, design composition/continuation patterns, and run a multi-agent feature-delivery team end to end.
